description: The Watcher (Сторож) follows a manager's positions against a Think Tank strategy and says when the strategy calls for an action (Telegram to the owner; in `agent` mode it audits the owner's agent). Price per manager per period in USDC (`priceUsdc` 0 = free beta), `periodDays`, how payment is taken (x402, in USDC) and the Telegram bot.
